release.name: RhoeLiquid Public Foundation
release.summary: The first public foundation candidate: engine, CLI, docs, service contracts, and runnable examples.

changes.title: DocC-native language reference
changes.detail: A self-contained reference now documents standard Liquid and RhoeLiquid extensions in one place.

changes.title: CLI artifacts
changes.detail: The repository includes a generated man page and shell completions for bash, zsh, and fish.

changes.title: Argument validation
changes.detail: Numeric CLI options now fail early when concurrency or iteration counts are not positive.

changes.title: Example gallery
changes.detail: Real templates now show HTML, Markdown, LaTeX, macros, filters, and data-driven rendering.
